kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أرتسم (form VIII)
# أَرْتَسِمُ (ʔartasimu) /ʔar.ta.si.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِرْتَسَمَ (irtasama)
# أَرْتَسِمَ (ʔartasima) /ʔar.ta.si.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَسَمَ (irtasama)
# أَرْتَسِمْ (ʔartasim) /ʔar.ta.sim/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِرْتَسَمَ (irtasama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
